title: Cutover lattice: preflight checklist and release notes (Jul 2026)
content:
Purpose and quick summary:

This is a compact, operational-first preflight and release-notes draft for the Jul 2026 cutover (feature set: routing policy + KV-cache persistence + minor SDK churn). Use this as the single source for on-call and release conductor during the 72h window. It intentionally mixes checklist items, calendar slots, and a short narrative release notes draft so SRE, platform, and product can copy/paste.

High-level goal:
- Ship routing-policy 2.1 with KV-cache persistence toggled on in dedicated clusters in NA-west, EU-west, and fall back to routing-policy 2.0 if latency regressions > 15% for 10 minutes.
- Maintain 99.9% p50 latency SLO and keep p95 within +30% of baseline.

Quick release timeline (UTC):
- T-72h (2026-07-10 09:00): Deadline for release-blocking PRs to be merged. Start smoke test baseline run.
- T-48h (2026-07-11 09:00): Canary deploy to NA-west canary pool (5% traffic). Start telemetry ramp.
- T-24h (2026-07-12 09:00): Expand to NA-west standard (50%) and EU-west canary (5%).
- T-6h  (2026-07-13 06:00): Quiet window begins for changes not in this release. Final data sync.
- Go window (2026-07-13 12:00): Full rollout to remaining clusters over 3 hours with staged cutoff lanes.
- Post-deploy monitoring window (2026-07-13 12:00–18:00): intensify alerts and run ops checklist.

Preflight checklist (T-minus 72h -> T-minus 24h) - ops focused
- [ ] Merge blockers cleared: confirm JIRA-RELEASE-2981 moved to "Ready" and all associated PRs labeled "release/2026-07". (Owner: Diego)
- [ ] Nightly baseline metrics collected for p50/p95/p99 token latency and token cost. Attach baseline graphs to the release Confluence page. (Owner: Elliot)
- [ ] End-to-end smoke harness executed against staging: prompt set A-1 and A-2. Validate semantic parity and log diff counts. (Owner: Ruth)
- [ ] KV-cache persistence migration dry-run completed on staging and canary. Verify cache warmup time < 1.2s and miss-rate < 6%.
- [ ] Autoscaler policy adjusted for new memory footprint: minimum pods, burst thresholds validated. (Owner: SRE lead)
- [ ] Rollback recipe tested: deploy routing-policy 2.0 artifact and validate graceful downgrade of connections within 90s. (Owner: release engineer)
- [ ] Secrets and KMS rotation window confirmed with Security. No key changes during go window.
- [ ] Docs: SDK changelog draft posted to product slack, and migration note included in release notes.

Canary and telemetry knobs (what to watch)
- Make sure these dashboards are pinned in the launch shift binder:
  - Serving runtime: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency by model family.
  - KV-cache: hit/miss ratio, TTL distribution, warmup latencies.
  - Cost: per-token cost delta (rolling 10m).
  - Error budget burn: 5xx by service, auth errors, grpc timeouts.
- Canary acceptance gates (automated):
  - Latency delta p95 <= +20% for 10m window
  - Error rate (5xx) increase <= 0.1% absolute
  - Quality regression: BLEU/ROUGE signals on eval set within thresholds (see eval-run id: eval-2026-07-09-21)
- Manual gate: if any gate fails, immediate pause and escalate to release conductor and on-call SRE.

Go window runbook (hourly cadence)
- 0:00 (start): announce on #release-ops: "rolling to NA-east + APAC (if scheduled)". Post canary snapshot link.
- 0:30: run smoke tests again against a sampling of p1 endpoints. Confirm no authentication regressions.
- 1:00: expand to next lane (30% traffic). Monitor the four telemetry knobs.
- 2:00: expand to 60% if green. Otherwise hold.
- 3:00: full rollout complete. Confirm telemetry steady for 30m before ending active watch.

Rollback decision matrix (quick)
- Immediate rollback triggers:
  - p95 > +30% sustained for 15m AND user-facing errors > 0.2%
  - Critical regression in routing policy causing cross-tenant leakage (SEC)
  - KV-cache corruption observed in > 1% of requests
- If triggered: use prebuilt rollback job (GH-PR-rollback-4521), notify product and security, fail traffic over to routing-policy 2.0 pools.

Post-release checklist (0–30 days)
- [ ] 0–6h: confirm incident-free status and daily report to #product-launch
- [ ] 24h: capture telemetry deltas and publish short metrics note
- [ ] 72h: run quality eval on expanded prompt set B-1 and B-2; file tickets for any regressions
- [ ] 30d: retrospective and perf review to decide whether to keep KV-cache persistence at default on dedicated clusters

Draft release notes (copyable)
Title: Routing policy 2.1 + KV-cache persistence (July 2026)
Highlights:
- Rolling launch of routing-policy 2.1: improved fallback logic and faster region-aware routing for lower token latency in multi-region apps (NA/EU).
- KV-cache persistence: service-side cache persistence to reduce cold-start token costs and improve tail latency for longer sessions. Enabled by default in Dedicated clusters after rollout.
- SDK patch: small client SDK changes that can require a quick pin for older customers (see migration note).

Migration notes (short):
- No mandatory customer action for hosted API users. Dedicated customers should plan a short maintenance window if they rely on custom autoscaler settings. See migration doc: confluence:/release/kv-cache-persistence-guides
- If pinning older SDKs, use client v1.8.3-compat until your team validates v1.9.0.

Known issues (early):
- Intermittent elevated cold-warm transition latency observed in staging for large-models ( > 70K params per request) — mitigation: increase cache TTL to 45s while we investigate (ticket JIRA-OPS-4620).
- Small fraction (~0.05%) of canary requests show auth token refresh race; patch GH-PR-4567 in flight.

Notes to self / TODOs (rough)
- Add a short note in the console UI about "cache warmup" behavior for users creating long-running sessions.
- Confirm billing labels flow to finance for dedicated clusters (owner: finance-eng liaison).
- Postmortem template pre-created for team in case we hit rollback triggers.
- Follow up: schedule a 30m post-launch debrief with product, platform, and SRE (proposed: 2026-07-14 14:00 UTC).

Appendix: quick links
- Baseline graphs: confluence:/dashboards/latency-baseline-2026-07
- Smoke harness results: GH-Actions: run/39982
- PRs in release: GH-PR-4499, GH-PR-4521 (rollback job), GH-PR-4567 (auth patch)
- Main release ticket: JIRA-RELEASE-2981

If anything unclear, ping me (Avery) in #release-ops or DM. This doc is intentionally compact; expand any section into a full runbook if handoff to an on-call who wasn't here for planning.

End of doc.
